description: Offline S1000D authoring and publishing server.

runtime.notes: WP-13 (ENT-008, DEP-018): the Node.js runtime the installer ships. Node 24 is the LTS line (security support to 2028-04-30). scripts/package-windows.mjs refuses any other major, a patch older than this pin, and a runtime with less than minSupportMonths of support left; scripts/ci/readiness.mjs (G-SEC-11b) applies the same rule. Patch cadence: docs/BUNDLED-COMPONENTS.md.

notes: publisher, copyright and url are shown in Add/Remove Programs, the installer and the executables' Properties > Details. They are placeholders: set them to the organisation that distributes the product (an empty copyright becomes 'Copyright (C) <year> <publisher>'). appId must never change once an installer has been released (it is how upgrades find the installed copy).
